name: Gottfried Schulz

events.place: Konary, Konin Powiat, Kalisz Department, Duchy of Warsaw

notes: According to SGGEE, Gottfried Schulz was married two times.  The first marriage was to a Dorothea Elizabeth Pade (sggee i110970) who died in Poland Aug. 9, 1845.  Anna Dorothea Zelmer (I1728) was his second wife.
